text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn). Zenno 
Rob Roy declared before the gathered 
press, "I am launching my bid to claim the 
Senior Autumn Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The "Autumn Senior Triple Crown"—a title 
bestowed only upon those who have 
conquered the Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan 
Cup, and Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Many heroes have risen, but only one ever 
claimed that title—the "Overlord of the 
Century's End," T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
"I shall raise my sword――the proof of a 
hero―― high, high into the sky! Strong, 
sharp, and overwhelming! So high that it 
catches everyone's eye!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
"I will never surrender the title of 
Hero." With fierce determination burning 
in her heart, Zenno Rob Roy stepped forth 
into the race.
